1. (Currently amended) A method of treating Argininosuccinate Synthetase Deficiency (ASD) in a human subject, the method comprising administering to the subject in need of treatment a composition comprising an mRNA encoding argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS1) encapsulated within a liposome comprising cationic lipid, non-cationic lipid, cholesterol, and PEGylated lipid at an effective dose and an administration interval such that at least one symptom or feature of the ASD is reduced in intensity, severity, or frequency or has its onset delayed.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the liposome comprises one or more cationic lipids, one or more non-cationic lipids, one or more cholesterol-based lipids and one or more PEG-modified lipids.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the one or more cationic lipids, one or more non-cationic lipids, one or more cholesterol-based lipids and one or more PEG-modified lipids are present in a ratio of approximately 40:30:20:10 by molar ratio.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise a cationic lipid selected from the group consisting of C12-200, MC3, DLinDMA, DLinkC2DMA, cKK-E12, ICE (Imidazol-based), HGT5000, HGT5001, DODAC, DDAB, DMRIE, DOSPA, DOGS, DODAP, DODMA and DMDMA, DLenDMA, CLinDMA, CpLinDMA, DMOBA, DOcarbDAP, DLinDAP, DLincarbDAP, DLinCDAP, KLin-K-DMA, DLin-K-XTC2-DMA, HGT4003, and combinations thereof.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 4, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise cKK-E12.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the one or more cholesterol-based lipids are cholesterol and/or PEGylated cholesterol.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the one or more cationic lipids constitute about 30-50% of the liposome by weight.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises a combination selected from: cKK-E12, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; C12-200, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; HGT4003, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; or ICE, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome has a size less than about 100 nm.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is administered at the effective dose ranging from about 0.1 - 5.0 mg/kg body weight.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered intravenously.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the composition is administered once a week.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in increased serum ASS1 protein level.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced citrulline level in the subject as compared to the baseline citrulline level before the treatment.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced ammonia level in the subject as compared to the baseline ammonia level before the treatment.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is codon optimized.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the codon-optimized mRNA comprises SEQ ID NO:3.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA comprises one or more modified nucleotides.
